reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03 correctly identifies that BlobsByRange serves blobs without fork epoch filtering (lines 1063-1079 only check slot range, not epoch). However, this is by design: the deprecated RPC handler is intended to serve all blobs within the data_availability_boundary, which itself implements the fork transition logic (chain_spec.rs:823-833). The min_epoch_data_availability_boundary function returns max(deneb_fork_epoch, blob_retention_epoch) until blob_retention_epoch exceeds fulu_fork_epoch, at which point it switches to data_column retention. The boundary check at line 1021 (request_start_slot < oldest_blob_slot) naturally prevents serving post-Fulu blobs because blobs after Fulu are not stored in the blob DB—they exist only as data columns. The spec requirement (01e PROP-6a4369e9-inv-029, file outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json) expects explicit epoch filtering in the RPC handler, but the implementation achieves the same outcome via storage-level separation. Cited invariant: 'During transition, blob_sidecars_by_range must serve only pre-Fulu epoch blobs.' The code satisfies this via architectural design (storage layer separation) rather than explicit RPC-layer filtering. No protocol confusion is possible because post-Fulu blocks do not have blob sidecars to retrieve.
